questions.stem: A child presents with brown colored urine and oliguria for last 3 days. He has mild facial and pedal edema. His blood pressure is 126/90. He has +3 proteinuria with 100 red cell and a few granular casts. His creatinine is 0.9, urea is 56. What is his diagnosis?
